mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals a weak labor market that prompts central bank intervention, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.5%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 600) and consumer spending (RSAFS < 400000) indicates a broad-based demand slowdown that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 400000, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 95), industrial production is below trend, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated monetary policy support.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 95, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) signals an extreme monetary easing stance that boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS <= 0.1, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market indicated by monthly payroll growth above 130,000 (PAYEMS > 130000) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 130000, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer spending slowdown (RSAFS < 400000) indicates weakening demand that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 400000, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low industrial production (INDPRO < 95) and ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) signal a weak economy with accommodative monetary policy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
